critical_code_review_comments: import.tsx line 105 now reads: `s?.instruction || s?.text || s?.step || String(s)` — order is correct because the AI schema field takes precedence over legacy `text`/`step` keys.
Consider optionally decorating each step with `time` / `visualCue` from the same object for a richer /cook experience (nice-to-have, not required).
parseSteps() in recipe.tsx would still happily accept literal '[object Object]' if a future mapper regresses — a defensive `.filter(s => !s.includes('[object'))` would harden it. Not blocking.
openFullRecipe passes the whole markdown via router params; long AI outputs may hit URL-length limits. Consider a lightweight in-memory hand-off store when time permits.
